verdict.rationale: Amplitude's docs confirm core funnel/segmentation analytics ('Build funnels, segment users, answer why') which supports understanding user behavior around key events, but no evidence explicitly describes a dedicated Path/Pathfinder analysis feature for exploring what users do before or after an event. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a path-analysis or journey-mapping feature, and independent/hands-on confirmation of using it to trace pre/post-event user flows.
